#!/bin/sh
#MISE description="Run E2E canary tests with deterministic agents (no API calls)"
#USAGE arg "[filter]" help="Test name filter (regex)" default=""

set -eu

# Build entire CLI
mise run build
export E2E_ENTIRE_BIN="$PWD/entire"

# Build vogon binary
go build -o vogon ./e2e/vogon

# Install roger-roger binaries (external agent canary)
ROGER_ROGER_MODULE="${ROGER_ROGER_MODULE:-github.com/entireio/roger-roger}"
echo "installing roger-roger binaries from $ROGER_ROGER_MODULE"
GOBIN="$PWD/bin" go install "$ROGER_ROGER_MODULE/cmd/roger-roger@latest" "$ROGER_ROGER_MODULE/cmd/entire-agent-roger-roger@latest"

export PATH="$PWD/bin:$PWD:$PATH"

if [ -z "${E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR:-}" ]; then
  E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR="$PWD/e2e/artifacts/canary-$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H-%M-%S)"
fi
export E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR
mkdir -p "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR"
echo "artifacts: $E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR"

filter="${usage_filter:-}"
rc=0

for agent in vogon roger-roger; do
  echo "--- canary: $agent ---"
  E2E_AGENT="$agent" gotestsum --format dots \
    --jsonfile "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR/test-events-${agent}.json" -- \
    -tags=e2e -count=1 -timeout=10m \
    ${filter:+-run "$filter"} \
    ./e2e/tests/... || rc=$?

  go run ./e2e/cmd/testreport -color \
    -o "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR/report-${agent}.txt" \
    "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR/test-events-${agent}.json"
done

echo ""
cat "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR/entire-version.txt" 2>/dev/null
echo "artifacts: $E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR"
exit "$rc"
